baseline.quality_semantics: numerical CONVERGED plus declared 0–1000 m operational bounds; truth is not consulted
baseline.calibration_semantics: fitted affine clock calibration remains UNVERIFIED; fit quality is not trust provenance

evaluation_thresholds.classification: engineering evaluation threshold, fixed before campaign execution; not a physical service requirement

metrics.availability_denominators: all requested epochs; report input, numerical and quality-accepted availability separately
metrics.error_metrics: conditional on numerical estimates with offline truth match; always report evaluable count and availability
metrics.false_confidence: accepted estimates with error >10m / all accepted estimates
metrics.rejected_good_numerical_point: returned numerical estimates rejected by bounds whose post-estimation error is <=10m; does not estimate false rejection among missing outputs
metrics.recovery: estimate-loss detection is first non-accepted epoch; recovery requires three consecutive accepted epochs after service loss; if service remains accepted throughout, mark recovery not applicable

radio_and_clock_model: 2D geometric LOS propagation, per-anchor affine clocks, deterministic fitted synthetic beacon pairs, seeded Gaussian jitter, temporal quantization, packet omission and timestamp corruption.
explicitly_not_modeled: FREQUENCIA engine execution in this analytic harness
interpretation_constraints: GroundTruth is never an estimator input
simulated timestamp resolution != hardware clock accuracy
